IST 'today' for recordings/maturity; real calendar parsing and future guard for growth/AUM dates
Mandate paise shown exactly; unknown-outcome checks; client-values gating matches routes

Identity follow-up: admin contact correction before password set, closed accounts release contacts (history kept), 24h invite links, invite link marks email verified

tasks.brief: Lane track/a-client-values: A1 growth idempotency (held key per submit, form lock, honest unknown outcome, invalidate positions/ledger), A2 failed-read states on client-values screens incl. EarlierInvestmentForm fund picker, A5 growth/AUM real date parsing + future guard and server paise parsing aligned with contract. Move touched hooks out of adminQueries.ts into client-values query modules; do not touch admin-money.ts.

Lane track/a-payments-off: A3 refuse lump-sum order and SIP creation with DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE when no payment gateway; SIP worker creates no instalment without gateway; honest client copy for lump sum and AutoPay-disabled; tests for refusal and worker skip. Never enable payments or change payment env.

Lane track/a-admin-core: A2 failed-read states for fund-aum (no init form on failure), overview tiles, AdminFrame requiresAll, email pickers; A4 app-config publish expected-version guard (optional request field so released admin APKs still publish) + conflict copy + test; A6 exact paise formatting on mandate screens without changing the response contract, unknown-outcome checks on application/refund/receipt screens.

Lane track/a-onboarding: A7 non-identity fixes (create-client review step, field-level duplicate errors, +91 length, recordContribution account-state check, held key + honest unknown outcome on user page and password-link panel, eligibility failure state instead of verify-email redirect, honest already-verified copy, expired-link 'request new link', web-neutral password success copy, invited label in directory, repaired onboarding harness wired into CI) and A5 IST calendar 'today' for recordings and maturity. Identity rule changes (Q-017/Q-024/Q-025) excluded.

Lane track/a-identity (after A-L4 lands): audited admin contact correction for clients without a password (retire old links, invite the corrected address); closed accounts release email/phone via an explicit audited action that keeps the original contacts in an append-only history table (additive migration 064) and frees the live columns without breaking the previous release's lookups; separate 24h invite (set) link lifetime config while reset links and email codes stay 10 min; password set through an invite/reset link marks the email at that revision verified. Tests for each (identity/auth critical) plus populated-upgrade test.
